COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
WPSB No.469 of 2024
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Mahavir Kohli, learned counsel for
petitioner.
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned Brief Holder
for State of Uttarakhand.
3. Petitioner is serving as Physician in
department of Medical Health and Family
Welfare since 1994; presently he is posted at
Coronation Hospital, District Dehradun. He is
aggrieved by order dated 26.07.2024 passed by
Secretary of concerned department whereby
Dr. Rajeev Singh Pal (respondent no.3) has
been posted as Principal Medical
Superintendent, Coronation Hospital, District
Dehradun.
4. According to petitioner, he is senior to
respondent no.3, therefore, respondent no.3
could not have been posted as Principal Medical
Superintendent in a hospital, where petitioner
was holding charge as Chief Medical
Superintendent.
5. Learned State Counsel was asked to get
instructions.
6. Today, on instructions, learned State
Counsel submits that petitioner was promoted
as Additional Director, Medical Health and
Family Welfare Department vide order dated
21.09.2022 and he joined on the promoted post
on 26.09.2022 however, on 12.10.2022,
petitioner made a representation that due to
health reasons, he is not in a position to
discharge duties as Additional Director and he

may be posted as Physician, where he can
serve the patients.
7. Learned State Counsel has produced the
application submitted by petitioner on
12.10.2022, which is taken on record.
8. Perusal of said application indicates that
petitioner had expressed his reluctance to
discharge duties on administrative post.
9. Thus, learned State Counsel submits that
due to disinclination shown by petitioner to
serve on administrative post, petitioner was not
offered promotion this time and respondent
no.3 was promoted as Principal Medical
Superintendent of Coronation Hospital, District
Dehradun.
10. Learned State Counsel, however submits
that if petitioner expresses his willingness to
hold administrative post by making a
representation, then petitioner's claim for
posting on administrative post shall be
considered against available vacancies,
wherever available.
11. Learned counsel for petitioner, on
instructions, submits that petitioner is now
ready to serve on administrative post,
therefore, he will indicate his willingness by
making a representation.
12. Writ petition is accordingly, disposed of by
directing that in the event petitioner expresses
his willingness to hold administrative post, then
Secretary, Medical Health shall consider
petitioner's claim and pass appropriate order,
as per his seniority, assigning him
administrative position, wherever vacancies is
available.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 02.08.2024
